scope: pure fail-closed seven-phase native shutdown evidence validator
contract: Exactly ordered clean_baseline, booted, workload_live, workload_retired_pre_stop, destroyed_resources_released_provider_present, fully_unloaded and policy_restored phases.
Independent immutable expectations bind process identities/starttimes, procfs state/nodes/status/maps digests, devices/sysfs, module refcounts/holders, CPU mask, IRQ inventory/affinity and policy.
CPU and per-NUMA reserve queries must succeed and be empty before provider unload.
Missing, duplicate, out-of-order, unknown, truncated or error observations fail closed; exclusive evidence publication failure cannot pass.
Output remains diagnostic-only and explicitly denies application acceptance.

preserved_failure.finding: The first candidate accepted IRQ affinity drift and self-supplied process/procfs expectations; independent review rejected it.

limitations: No Rocky integration, root operation, build, QEMU guest, shutdown or recreate cycle has run.
